snippet.title: IRON SOL - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
IRON SOL comes out on Steam on November 2nd 2026!
Wishlist it at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271880/IRON_SOL/

Inspired by the greats like Rain World and Celeste, I hope you will give my little passion project a chance.

IRON SOL is a difficult semi-open world 2D platformer with a focus on gradual exploration, atmosphere, and unusual but fun platforming mechanics. Your abilities are limited only by your own knowledge. The more abilities you know how to use, the more open the world becomes.
